bug_root_cause_analysis.bug_description: Users cannot add a room to a project's walkthrough in the mobile app when project has ZERO rooms
bug_root_cause_analysis.root_cause: In TabbedWalkthroughSpreadsheet.js, when project.rooms.length === 0, the component returns early (around line 562-687) showing 'No Rooms Available' message. The showAddRoom state was being set to true when clicking 'ADD FIRST ROOM', BUT the modal JSX was only rendered in the main return statement (around line 2484+), which was never reached due to the early return.
bug_root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Duplicated the Add Room modal JSX (lines 577-685) inside the early-return block so it renders when showAddRoom=true even for zero-rooms case
